scenario.workload: One HTML navigation per virtual user, followed by think time; routes rotate.
excluded: real browser execution and interaction CPU
scenario.readiness: Full-target hold starts only after every VU completes a verified successful first page response.
scenario.responseVerification: HTTP 200, HTML content type, streamed decompression, route-specific title, SHA-256 of the entire decoded response matching the known build, minimum bytes and matching Content-Length when supplied.
